columns.comment: Workflow date: the due date of annual reviews and spreading tasks, the submission date of new-money, amendment and watchlist reviews. "Reviews due in Q3 FY2026" = Fiscal Quarter FY2026-Q3 (Oct-Dec 2026, in the future). Today is 30-Sep-2026 (never CURRENT_DATE).
columns.name: Date

columns.comment: Calendar month of the workflow item (due date or submission date for requests) as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01'. Point-in-time measures grouped by Month return the month's last date (month-end); the latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year of the workflow date (the due date of annual reviews and spreading tasks, the submission date of requests), April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027. Not the year of the financials: "FY2025 financials" (spread, reviewed or not yet spread) = Review Fiscal Year 'FY2025'.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: True on the last calendar day of a month (the month-end snapshot date of the workflow item (due date or submission date for requests)).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics, Sunda Energi Nusantara). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match names with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'. About 380 groups.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: Legal entity (golden client) with its location, e.g. Kinokawa Precision (Singapore) Pte Ltd - "entity" or "subsidiary" means this level. About 2,500 entities; match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%Singapore%'.
columns.name: Client

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for APAC subsidiaries of Japanese groups (segment Japanese Corporate) - "Japanese corporates", "JC" or "Japanese clients" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Industry sector of the APAC taxonomy (e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy, Industrials); see Subsector.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Industry subsector within the sector (e.g. Semiconductors, Automotive Parts, Coal Mining, Shipping).
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: APAC booking location covering the client, ISO-2 code: SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand. "Country" means this unless the user says risk / HQ country.
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Primary relationship manager (fictional name) at the row's month-end: the CRM primary-RM assignment, else the group account-plan owner; null = no RM coverage.
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the primary RM sits - "RMs in Singapore / Hong Kong" means this (most RMs also cover clients booked in other countries, so it differs from Coverage Office).
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Internal rating grade 1-10 in force at the row's month-end (1 best, 10 default; 7 and worse is sub-investment watch territory); null = not rated (no credit relationship).
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage at the row's month-end: 1 performing, 2 significant increase in credit risk, 3 credit-impaired / default; null = not rated.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist at the row's month-end ("not on the watchlist" = false).
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating Low, Medium or High at the row's month-end (latest completed review); null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Final early-warning band at the row's month-end: Green (score < 40), Amber (40-69) or Red (>= 70), after overrides; null = not scored (no credit relationship, or before Apr-2025).
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Annual (annual credit review), New Money (new facility / increase), Amendment, Watchlist (watchlist review) or Financial Spreading (spreading of a statement year).
columns.name: Review Type

columns.comment: Status at 30-Sep-2026. Reviews: Not Started, In Preparation, Overdue, Submitted - Awaiting Approval, Approved, Declined. Spreading: Received - Not Started, In Progress, Checked.
columns.name: Status

columns.comment: Credit decision: Approved, Approved with Conditions or Declined (null while undecided and for spreading).
columns.name: Outcome

columns.comment: Credit analyst preparing the memo or spreading the statements (fictional name).
columns.name: Analyst

columns.comment: Credit approver deciding the memo, or the checker of a spread (fictional name); null until assigned.
columns.name: Approver

columns.comment: Statement fiscal year whose financials are reviewed or spread (FY2025 = the FY2025 financials) - "FY2025 financials" always means this field, not Fiscal Year (the year of the workflow date); null for new-money, amendment and watchlist reviews. "FY2025 financials not yet spread" = Review Fiscal Year 'FY2025' + Review Type 'Financial Spreading' + Is Not Yet Spread.
columns.name: Review Fiscal Year

columns.comment: True when the due date has passed (before 30-Sep-2026) and the memo / spread is not submitted.
columns.name: Is Overdue

columns.comment: True for spreading tasks whose statements are not yet spread.
columns.name: Is Not Yet Spread

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half of the approval / decision date (e.g. FY2026-H1 = Apr-Sep 2026); null while undecided. It also holds declined decisions: "approved in H1 FY2026" = Approval Fiscal Half 'FY2026-H1' + Outcome IN ('Approved', 'Approved with Conditions').
columns.name: Approval Fiscal Half

columns.comment: Credit reviews and spreading tasks in the selection.
columns.name: Workflow Items

columns.comment: Annual reviews and spreading tasks due in the selected period (Date = due date). Always 0 for new-money, amendment and watchlist requests (they have no due date) - count those with Workflow Items or Approved.
columns.name: Reviews Due

columns.comment: Number of items past due and not submitted at 30-Sep-2026 (a count of items, not days - for days overdue use Average Days Overdue or Max Days Overdue).
columns.name: Overdue

columns.comment: Overdue items / items due in the selection (fraction).
columns.name: Overdue Rate %

columns.comment: Average days past due at 30-Sep-2026 over the overdue items.
columns.name: Average Days Overdue

columns.comment: Days past due at 30-Sep-2026 of the longest-overdue item in the selection - "maximum days overdue"; for one item (e.g. one client's spreading task) its days overdue.
columns.name: Max Days Overdue

columns.comment: Average days submitted after the due date, over items submitted late (Sunda's FY2025 annual review = 23).
columns.name: Average Days Late

columns.comment: Items submitted after their due date.
columns.name: Submitted Late

columns.comment: Average days from preparation start (statements received) to submission (spread); to 30-Sep-2026 for items still in preparation.
columns.name: Average Days in Preparation

columns.comment: Average end-to-end days from preparation start (request) to approval / decision, over decided items.
columns.name: Average Days to Approval

columns.comment: Number of reviews approved (with or without conditions) - the count of approvals, e.g. new-money approvals by Approval Fiscal Half.
columns.name: Approved

columns.comment: Reviews approved (with or without conditions) on their first submission.
columns.name: Approved First Time

columns.comment: Share of approved reviews approved on the first submission (fraction).
columns.name: Approved on First Submission %

columns.comment: Credit memos submitted but not yet decided at 30-Sep-2026.
columns.name: Memos Awaiting Approval

columns.comment: Spreading tasks whose statements are not yet spread at 30-Sep-2026.
columns.name: Not Yet Spread

columns.comment: Amount requested in new-money reviews, USD (a flow over the selected reviews). For approved amounts add Outcome IN ('Approved', 'Approved with Conditions') - otherwise declined requests are included.
columns.name: Requested Amount USD

columns.comment: Amount-weighted average proposed margin of new-money requests in basis points.
columns.name: Weighted Margin bps

comment: Credit review and financial-spreading workflow of SMBC APAC: reviews due (annual reviews, spreading tasks), submitted, approved; overdue items and days overdue at 30-Sep-2026; days late, in preparation and to approval; approved on first submission; memos awaiting approval; FY2025 statements not yet spread; new-money amount and amount-weighted margin. Date = due date (annual reviews, spreading) or submission date (new money, amendment, watchlist); approvals by approval date use Approval Fiscal Half. Statuses are as of today (30-Sep-2026). Grain: one row per credit review or spreading task (gold.fact_credit_review_workflow).
